name: JustForFans Downloader
headline: TellaTV Downloader: Save Videos as MP4
short_description: TellaTV Downloader is a browser extension designed for users who want to easily save Tella videos for offline viewing. It allows you to download videos from Tella pages and supported embeds, providing a user-friendly workflow for exporting videos as MP4 files.
author: serpdownloaders

sections.overview:
TellaTV Downloader is a browser extension built for saving Tella videos and screen recordings locally as MP4 files. It detects video streams on direct Tella pages and supported embedded players, then exports them for offline playback on any standard media player. The extension works through a simple browser-based workflow—load a Tella page, press play, and use the in-page control or extension popup to download. It supports screen recordings, presentations, demos, and walkthroughs, making it useful for teams archiving content, professionals saving training materials, and anyone wanting to keep local copies without desktop recording software. The extension includes 3 free downloads to test the workflow before upgrading to unlimited downloads.
Save Tella videos and screen recordings as MP4 files
Download supported Tella embeds from third-party websites
Keep local copies of presentations and demos
Use in-page controls for quick access to downloads
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/serpdownloaders/skills --skill tellatv-downloader`
`git clone https://github.com/serpdownloaders/tellatv-downloader`
sections.usage:
```
Download the video from the following Tella page: [Tella_VIDEO_URL]. Ensure the download is in MP4 format, 1080p quality if available, and save it to a folder named 'Tella_Downloads' on my desktop. Do not include any watermarks or ads in the final file.
```
